en.bdb: Progeny of the Sikhs of Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਅੰਡਾ ਸੇਂਵਦਾ ਜਲ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kachhoo a(n)ddaa se(n)vadhaa jal baahar dhar dhiaan dhara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Tortoise hatches its eggs out side water and keeping track of those rears them up.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੰਜ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਸਿਮਰਣੋ ਪੂਰਣ ਬਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਡੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: koo(n)j kare(n)dhee simarano pooran bachaa hoi udda(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: By virtue of the mother's remembrance the young one of the heron bird starts flying in the sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਕੜੀ ਬਚਾ ਪਾਲਦੀ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੋ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kukaRee bachaa paaladhee muragaiee no jai mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The kid of waterfowl is reared up by hen but ultimately it goes to meet its mother ( waterfowl).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਾਵਣੀ ਲੋਹੂ ਲੋਹੂ ਰਲੈ ਰਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: koil paalai kaavanee lohoo lohoo ralai rala(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The offsprings of nightingale are nurtured by female crow but finally the blood goes to meet the blood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਅਤੇ ਚਕੋਰ ਕੁਲ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: chakavee ate chakor kul siv sakatee mil mel kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Moving around in the illusions of Siva and Sakti (maya) the female ruddy sheldrake and Indian red legged partridge also ultimately meet their beloved ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਸੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਦਿਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dh sooraj se jaaneean chhia rut baareh maeh dhisa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Among the stars, the sun and the moon are perceptible throughout the six seasons and the twelve months.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਸਚ ਦਾ ਕਵੀਆਂ ਕਵਲ ਭਵਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh melaa sach dhaa kaveeaa(n) kaval bhavar vigasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: As the black bee is happy among lilies and lotuses,
The gurmukhs get delighted to perceive the truth and attain the fruit of pleasures.
